rule:
python measure8_s3.py dir      8.1: the past-shape inflow split by the direction of the change. The thinned main rows (|s_W| >= 0.2 m) of
                                 code 11 (and 13 apart) of every result's metric rows (cls = the four-way judgment of metrics_s1.spread);
                                 '늘어난 곳' = the GT lies outside the prior surface (row value = GT - prior along the row's line direction
                                 D > 0: roofs D = +z, LoD2 walls D = the LoD2 surface normal of lod2_surfaces.json; ALS walls D = the patch
                                 normal flipped to z >= 0, so 'outside' is not guaranteed there: written apart), '줄어든 곳' = value < 0.
                                 The share = (wrong side + both) / all, as the inflow.
  python measure8_s3.py change   8.2 (LoD2 only): each LoD2 prior-error patch (code 11; 13 apart) is told by the ALS prior at the same GT points
                                 (the ALS rows of the same unit, matched by the GT point): the ALS patch's v3 true label agree (|ALS - GT| <= the
                                 ALS unit's tau) on the majority of the patch's matched points -> '표현 차이로 봄'; conflict -> '실제 변화로 봄';
                                 fewer than half of the patch's points with an ALS row (walls etc.) -> '가르지 못함'. Per class: area, points,
                                 inflow per result; and the 2 x 2 table with 8.1's direction.
